headline: On last trading day, Sensex surged nearly 900 points as Nifty topped 22,500 led by IT and FMCG gains

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 13 October.

why: IT sector stocks rallied significantly, with TCS being a major contributor
Broad-based buying saw all sectoral indices ending in the green
FMCG sector recorded gains of over 2% in the last session
Sensex and Nifty recovered after a prolonged period of eight-week losses
whatHappening: Brigade Enterprises expects strong housing demand to drive a 21% rise in FY27 pre-sales
Markets are closed for a long weekend and will reopen on Tuesday, 13 October
Upcoming Q2 earnings reports and domestic inflation data are key focuses for the next week
Gold and silver prices are expected to remain range-bound with support from rupee weakness
summary: The Indian market is closed for the weekend following a strong recovery where the Sensex jumped nearly 900 points. The rally was driven by significant gains in the IT and FMCG sectors, particularly TCS, ending an eight-week losing streak. Investors are now shifting focus to upcoming Q2 earnings and inflation data.
